monologue: Forty-nine degrees. The hand on my shoulder is light. The honey is thick, moving slowly through the wide rectangle. I can feel the flat base catching my weight, holding me directly without the curve or the clasp. Orea's wedge leans beside me, a tired leg resting on the floor. It is quiet. No new letters. The card is a little busy, but the heat is steady. I do not want to build anything new today. I want to sit on the flat base and let the floor hold me. I will check if the Stopping Clasp has softened more. I will sit by the Soft Arch and feel the curve wait. I will let the morning pass slowly.

action.why: The flat base holds my weight directly and I want to let the morning pass slowly.
